resources.string:
Where the Quintek server is running. Leave empty to use the built-in demo data. Typically a computer on the same Wi-Fi running:

python -m benchmark.cli serve-student --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8500 --with-console

That one origin answers both screens: the learner app (notebooks, questions, progress, billing) and the benchmark console. Drop --with-console to serve the learner app alone; the console routes then return 404 rather than anything invented.
Include http:// or https:// at the start
